scope: Area-constrained compact self-timed 6T sizing and control-routing characterization; this manifest is a protocol, not a pass record

baseline.area_metric: Actual complete GDS bounding-box area, including controller, registers, periphery and supply grid

architecture.stage_counts: Retain existing setup, settling and completion references unless separately validated
architecture.legacy_scope: No sizing override for legacy/10T or unlisted joint classes

candidates.peripheral_screen: Compare original classes with PRE2, WD4/input1, and their combination
candidates.control_metal_screen: Compare original bars, 270 nm M4 bars and 500 nm parallel M6 straps with matched terminal extraction
candidates.clock_credit: Use joint electrical evidence; do not add independent sizing and metal savings on the same RC path

verification.physical: Actual area ceiling, DRC 0, LVS CORRECT and distributed R+C+CC; preserve all supply pins, supply mesh and kit contact/via resistance
verification.waveforms: Read, write, hold, sense polarity/margin, nonoverlap and complete recovery before capture; inspect controller and physical far-end crossings
verification.complete_restoration: All bitlines within 2 percent of VDD, PRE fully on, enables and all latent completion/guard states reset
verification.guard_launch: Use 50 percent crossings for event-model changes; retain the independent 1.5-times settling and completion checks
verification.mismatch: Explicit per-device vth0/u0/voff samples with recorded seed and sigma; nominal coupons do not establish yield
verification.larger_arrays: Measured anchors plus explicitly labeled conditional timing estimates are authorized; physical receipts do not establish waveform qualification
verification.clock_policy: One 10 percent margin after the completed cycle/access budget; round upward to 50 ps

evidence_requirements: nominal or per-device variation, seed and sigma
RC provenance, coupling treatment and any reduction
measured, modeled and unqualified scopes kept distinct
local_runner_note: Python waveform and characterization runners live under ignored tests/ and dev/; a fresh clone does not include them.
